summary.text: Eddie Lambert is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 18, representing Ascension, Livingston, St. James, according to the Senate member page.
The page lists 2015 as the year elected.
The page lists Eddie Lambert with committee assignments including Environmental Quality (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The Senate member page lists Eddie Lambert's education as Louisiana State University, B.A. (1978); LSU, J.D. (1982).

The Senate member page lists Eddie Lambert's committee assignments as Environmental Quality (Chair); Natural Resources; Revenue and Fiscal Affairs; Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development (Ex Officio); Senate Select Committee on Homeland Security (Vice Chair); Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
